<h2>Validate Calibration Evidence Before Production Tuning</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Rechecks current representative preparation and saved calibration inputs
before a production tier can launch tuning. A published label is not proof.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_sjsdm_cv_production_calibration(
  profile_id,
  data_representatives = NULL,
  validate_preparation_function = validate_sjsdm_cv_preparation_freshness,
  validate_evidence_function = validate_sjsdm_cv_calibration_evidence,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw,
  load_evidence_function = qs2::qs_read
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="profile_id">profile_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Main spatial or paleo-temporal configuration profile.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_representatives">data_representatives</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional representative inventory. Defaults to the published CSV.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="validate_preparation_function">validate_preparation_function</code>, <code id="validate_evidence_function">validate_evidence_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable preparation freshness and calibration compatibility checks.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code>, <code id="load_evidence_function">load_evidence_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable cached production target and calibration evidence readers.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisibly, 'NULL' when the required evidence is compatible.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
validate_sjsdm_cv_production_calibration("project_modern_spatial_local")

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
